## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes; UI changes also pass `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented scope
- [ ] English/Chinese copy and documentation are updated together; source data and outgoing text are unchanged
- [ ] No credentials, private notes, databases or authenticated API recordings
- [ ] Storage/delivery changes explain migration, recovery and duplicate-send implications
